author: mark
text:
prompt: spawn exchange branch + step commits

v0.2's first cut of ARCH §2.3's branch invariant for exchanges.
`lernie prompt` now spawns `ex/<ts>-<id>` off main with a worktree
at `<repo>/.lernie/worktrees/ex/<ts>-<id>/`, writes `.agent/goal.md`
(§2.8), commits the snapshot before the model call (§2.10), invokes
the provider adapter, and lands the response as a follow-up commit
on the same branch. Main is untouched; merge-back (§2.6) is a
separate v0.2 task.

Step on-disk layout documented in ARCH §2.3: request.json +
response.json under \`exchanges/<id>/steps/<NNN>/\`, which v0.3 will
extend with tool_calls/ without moving the core files. §12 v0.1
exception note updated to mark direct-to-main commits retired.
